summary: The earliest missing behavior is potion.c::ghost_from_bottle, called by dodrink after the third milky-potion occupant roll succeeds. C creates a ghost at the hero coordinates; makemon relocates it through enexto_core/collect_coords, then ghost_from_bottle prints the emergence message and sets three forced-rest turns. JavaScript currently records note_unported(potion.c ghost_from_bottle), consumes the bottle, and returns without creating the ghost or setting the forced-rest state. The C collect_coords RNG annotation is downstream evidence of ghost placement, not an independent teleport.c defect.

source.branch: dodrink enters the milky-bottle arm when the descriptor is milky and ghosts are not gone; a zero result from rn2(13 + 2 * ghosts-born) calls ghost_from_bottle before useup and returns ECMD_TIME. ghost_from_bottle creates PM_GHOST at the hero square with MM_NOMSG, reports an empty bottle if creation fails, otherwise selects blind/sighted and hallucination wording, optionally prints the verbose fear message, then calls nomul(-3) and sets the forced-rest reason and recovery message.
callers: C: potion.c::dodrink calls ghost_from_bottle at potion.c:604; JS: js/potion.js::dodrink reaches note_unported('potion.c ghost_from_bottle') in the same milky/occupant gate at js/potion.js:2058-2064.
dependencies: makemon.c::makemon (ghost_from_bottle consumes the returned monster pointer to distinguish an empty bottle; the JS runtime call must use makemon_runtime so the full runtime suffix runs)

teleport.c::enexto_core -> teleport.c::collect_coords (makemon consumes the selected adjacent coordinate; enexto_core consumes the candidate list; existing JavaScript source ports are in js/teleport.js)
do_name.c::rndghostname (makemon consumes the ghost name when MM_NONAME is absent; the JavaScript makemon path already calls the helper)
do_name.c::rndmonnam (ghost_from_bottle consumes this name only in the hallucinating branch; JavaScript helper exists in js/do_name.js)
hack.c::nomul (void turn-interruption side effect already implemented in js/hack.js; ghost_from_bottle must also set the C multi_reason and nomovemsg state)
pline.c::pline and You (void message effects; current JavaScript terminal message operation is ttyPline)

evidence: The immutable C recording challenges/cases/v17/monk-quaffs-three-milky-potions-ghost-from-bottle-three-quaffs.session.json step 34 is key k. Its RNG begins rn2(13)=0 @ dodrink(potion.c:603), then rn2(8)=7 @ collect_coords(teleport.c:700); the captured screen says “As you open the bottle, an enormous ghost emerges!--More--”. The previous two quaff screens are ordinary potion effects. The step therefore reaches the successful third-bottle occupant branch.

nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:601-606 places ghost_from_bottle before useup and ECMD_TIME. The entire helper at nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:481-499 consumes makemon(PM_GHOST, u.ux, u.uy, MM_NOMSG), distinguishes failure, selects blindness/hallucination message text, and on success calls nomul(-3), sets gm.multi_reason, and sets gn.nomovemsg.

The reported RNG caller is downstream: nethack-c/upstream/src/makemon.c:1179-1185 sees the hero-square coordinate and calls enexto_core; nethack-c/upstream/src/teleport.c:242-257 calls collect_coords for nearby and whole-map candidates, whose shuffle at 697-708 emits the recorded rn2(8). Therefore the observed teleport.c RNG caller does not identify a teleport defect; it is caused by ghost_from_bottle reaching makemon.

Current JavaScript has the exact missing branch at js/potion.js:2058-2064: on the same milky/ghost-vital gate it calls note_unported('potion.c ghost_from_bottle'), then useup, then returns ECMD_TIME. It never creates the monster, writes the C emergence/fear messages, or applies the forced-rest state. The saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261001190602-v17.json records 34/35 matching screens and first mismatch at step 34; C cell is A versus JS Y and cursors are [58,0,1] versus [60,15,1].

Required production wiring is local to the existing caller: js/potion.js already imports makemon_runtime at line 164, whose async adapter preserves the full makemon runtime suffix (js/makemon_create.js:3233-3257); its makemon constructor calls enexto_core when the requested square is the hero square (js/makemon_create.js:2895-2921). The current teleport helper remains source-wired and uses the passed random environment (js/teleport.js:1148-1164).

Consumed-return dependencies are makemon (null versus created ghost), rndmonnam on the hallucination path, and enexto_core/collect_coords during placement. The helper itself is void and dodrink ignores its return. Current direct named gap is only the dodrink note_unported for ghost_from_bottle; no independent teleport source defect is established. This recording exercises the successful sighted, non-hallucinating path; empty-bottle, blind, hallucination, and verbose wording branches remain part of the whole helper scope but are not evidenced here.
